text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...The hell did you say?
Say that again!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ha, I'll say it as many times as it takes!
You don't have that fire in you like you used to—

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Entering such a well-mannered school has really softened you up, hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Hey. Can we make this training routine... a bit tougher?
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Someone I used to brawl with back in the day told me,
'You've really mellowed out.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, her weight had been on an upward trend. The change was even starting to show on the outside.
choice_data_list: Yeah... I might have gained a bit of weight lately.
Yeah... You might have gained a bit of weight recently.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right?
That's why we gotta push hard and get fired—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: Was that not what you meant?
Is that not what you meant?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're wrong! About being slack, or soft...
I mean, are you serious? Dammit.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, we're going all the way!
Drop the soft attitude. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: You've completely toned up, you look awesome!
You look so lean and fit, looking cool!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Then fine—
I won't let anyone say I've "gone soft" ever again.
